question.question: How is Vagabond capacity calculated, what counts toward load, when is it checked and where do excess items go?

expected.expected_answer: Last step Evening: Satchel plus Damaged load, limit six plus two per face-up bag on track. Track items excluded. Permanently remove chosen Satchel/Damaged items until limit; not immediate on acquisition.

source_passages.quotation: 4. **Capacity, the last step of Evening after drawing and discarding:** Satchel **plus Damaged box** may contain **six items plus two per face-up bag on its track**. Track items do not count toward load. Permanently remove chosen Satchel/Damaged items until within limit. Do not check capacity immediately upon acquiring an item.

answer.ruling: At Evening’s last step, Satchel plus the Damaged box may contain six items plus two per face-up bag on its track. Items on tracks do not count toward load.

Check capacity after drawing and discarding, as the last step of Evening. Permanently remove chosen items from Satchel or the Damaged box until within the limit. Do not check immediately when acquiring an item.
